name: Panama Product Import for WooCommerce (XML, CSV, YML, Excel)
author: PanamaCode

sections.description:
Panama Product Import is a fast and flexible WooCommerce product import plugin designed for dropshipping stores, marketplaces, supplier-based businesses and stores working with XML, CSV, YML and Excel supplier feeds.

Import products from local files or remote supplier feeds via URL and keep your WooCommerce catalog up to date with reliable batch processing, flexible field mapping, product synchronization and manual or automated workflows.

The plugin is designed for both small stores and large product catalogs, with a focus on stability, predictable import behavior and efficient resource usage.

🚀 Built for real WooCommerce stores

Perfect for:

  • Dropshipping stores
  • WooCommerce stores with multiple suppliers
  • Marketplaces and aggregators
  • Supplier-based businesses
  • Stores that need automated product updates

Designed for stores working with large product catalogs and frequently changing data such as prices, stock, availability and descriptions.

Built with a focus on stability, control and predictable import behavior — including large supplier catalogs.

• XML attributes (e.g. @id, @available)
• XML/YML parameters (param:name)
• CSV columns

sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to /wp-content/plugins/panama-product-import
    or install via the WordPress Plugins screen
  2. Activate the plugin
  3. Go to Panama Product Import
  4. Add your feed
  5. Configure field and category mapping
  6. Configure update settings
  7. Run the import
sections.faq:
What file formats are supported?

XML, CSV, YML and Excel (XLS / XLSX) feeds are supported.

Can I import large product catalogs?

Yes. The plugin uses batch processing and is designed to work with large supplier catalogs.

Can I import products from a supplier URL?

Yes. The plugin supports remote XML, CSV and YML supplier feeds via direct URL.

Can I import an Excel file?

Yes. Excel XLS and XLSX files can be imported as product feeds.

Can I pause and resume an import?

Yes. Import can be paused and resumed at any time. The import session is stored temporarily and may expire after a period of inactivity.

How are products updated?

Products are updated using the selected update key, such as SKU, article or vendorCode.

Does it support scheduled imports?

Scheduled imports using CRON are available in the Pro version.

Can I import only products that are in stock?

Yes. The Pro version allows you to import only products that are currently marked as available in the supplier feed.

Can I change the price of imported products?

Yes. The Pro version allows you to select the price field from the supplier feed and apply a global markup to imported products. The markup can be configured as a percentage or a fixed amount.

You can also configure separate markup rules for different product price ranges. Price-range rules have priority over the global markup.

Can I add additional product marking during import?

Yes. The Pro version allows you to add additional product marking using either a field from the supplier feed or a custom value.

What happens if a product disappears from the supplier feed?

The Pro version can detect products that were previously imported but are no longer present in the supplier feed and automatically move them to “Out of stock”.

What is the difference between Free and Pro?

The Free version provides core product import functionality for XML, CSV, YML and Excel feeds.

The Pro version adds MultiFeed support, scheduled CRON imports, advanced category and attribute management, advanced stock synchronization, price source selection, product markup rules, additional product marking and additional automation features.
